purpose: Preserve the strongest recoverable public-support record without flattening source classes, speaker roles, completeness, or public/private boundaries.

criteria.name: Bounded population closure
criteria.passCondition: Every full-text claim names its recoverable population: all attributed turns for selected formal-program speakers or all attributed quotations in one official source.

criteria.name: Source-class integrity
criteria.passCondition: Speech transcripts, press-release quotations, bill records, sponsor memos, and election results remain explicitly distinct.

criteria.name: Time-aware role attribution
criteria.passCondition: Each speaker has a role at the event; later election results do not retroactively confer office.

criteria.name: Protected locator boundary
criteria.passCondition: Public records contain no private paths, authenticated transcript URLs, personal email addresses, or raw audio locators.

criteria.name: No endorsement conversion
criteria.passCondition: Policy support is never represented as endorsement of Jamie or his portfolio.

criteria.name: Null findings remain visible
criteria.passCondition: A floor speech or other expected source that was not recovered is recorded as a bounded null finding, not invented or silently omitted.

humanGates: Jamie may correct names, event context, transcription, and role descriptions.
Publication beyond the governed Wiki remains a separate editorial decision.
Future source recovery expands the corpus only after the same checks pass.
